item.title: Custom Fields
item.description: Custom Fields let you attach your own structured data to DefectDojo records. Unlike the earlier free-form key/value metadata, custom fields are typed and defined up front: an administrator defines each field once (a label, a key, and a data type), and everyone else fills in a value of that type on the records they work with.

item.title: Archive
item.description: Archive removes an Organization, Asset, Engagement, Test or Finding from view without deleting it. Archived data stays in the database for a fixed retention period, and you can restore it at any point during that period. When the period ends, DefectDojo deletes the archived data permanently, together with its audit history.

item.title: Editable Platform, Lifecycle and Origin Lists
item.description: The Platform, Lifecycle and Origin fields on an asset used to be fixed lists that only DefectDojo could change. They are now editable lookup tables, so an administrator can rename the built-in options and add their own to match how the organization actually describes its assets. This works the same way the Environments list has always worked.

item.title: Asset Discovery
item.description: Asset Discovery lists the devices your endpoint security tool sees on your network that do not run its agent: printers, phones, cameras, network gear, and servers and laptops nobody onboarded. Your EDR already finds them, because its agents watch the network around them. DefectDojo collects those lists from the connectors you already run, so you can see the gap in one place.
